from pathlib import Path
from textwrap import dedent

PERSISTENCE = Path("src/news_bulletin_playlist/persistence.py")
PLANNER_TESTS = Path("tests/test_spotify_planner.py")


def replace_once(text: str, old: str, new: str, label: str) -> str:
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"{label}: expected exactly one match, found {count}")
    return text.replace(old, new)


persistence = PERSISTENCE.read_text()

matched_seed = '''            """\n            INSERT OR IGNORE INTO spotify_planner_persistence_rejection_state (\n                source_id, source_native_id, protected_status,\n                protected_spotify_episode_uri, protected_spotify_duration_seconds,\n                protected_match_updated_at, first_rejected_at, last_rejected_at\n            )\n            SELECT m.source_id, m.source_native_id, m.status, m.spotify_episode_uri,\n                   m.spotify_duration_seconds, m.updated_at,\n                   r.first_attempt_at, r.last_attempt_at\n            FROM spotify_matches AS m\n            JOIN spotify_planner_matched_recovery_state AS r\n              ON r.source_id = m.source_id\n             AND r.source_native_id = m.source_native_id\n            WHERE m.status = 'matched' AND m.updated_at > r.first_attempt_at\n            """,\n'''
unresolved_seed = '''            """\n            INSERT OR IGNORE INTO spotify_planner_persistence_rejection_state (\n                source_id, source_native_id, protected_status,\n                protected_spotify_episode_uri, protected_spotify_duration_seconds,\n                protected_match_updated_at, first_rejected_at, last_rejected_at\n            )\n            SELECT m.source_id, m.source_native_id, m.status, m.spotify_episode_uri,\n                   m.spotify_duration_seconds, m.updated_at,\n                   u.first_unresolved_at, u.last_attempt_at\n            FROM spotify_matches AS m\n            JOIN spotify_planner_unresolved_state AS u\n              ON u.source_id = m.source_id\n             AND u.source_native_id = m.source_native_id\n            WHERE m.status != 'matched' AND m.updated_at > u.last_attempt_at\n            """,\n'''
persistence = replace_once(persistence, matched_seed, "", "remove matched static seed")
persistence = replace_once(persistence, unresolved_seed, "", "remove unresolved static seed")

old_loop = '''            for version, statements in _MIGRATIONS:\n                if version <= current:\n                    continue\n                for statement in statements:\n                    connection.execute(statement)\n                connection.execute(\n                    "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, applied_at) VALUES (?, ?)",\n                    (version, _format_timestamp(datetime.now(UTC))),\n                )\n'''
new_loop = '''            for version, statements in _MIGRATIONS:\n                if version <= current:\n                    continue\n                for statement in statements:\n                    connection.execute(statement)\n                if version == 7:\n                    self._seed_persistence_rejection_barriers(connection)\n                connection.execute(\n                    "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, applied_at) VALUES (?, ?)",\n                    (version, _format_timestamp(datetime.now(UTC))),\n                )\n'''
persistence = replace_once(persistence, old_loop, new_loop, "initialize migration hook")

marker = '''    def schema_version(self) -> int:\n        """Return the latest applied migration version."""\n        with self._connection("read schema version") as connection:\n            return self._schema_version(connection)\n\n'''
helper = marker + '''    @staticmethod\n    def _seed_persistence_rejection_barriers(connection: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n        """Migrate only implicit barriers that can be reconstructed safely.\n\n        Some historical/synthetic databases contain only the tables needed by the migration\n        under test. Creating the v7 table remains valid there, but attempting a DML insert into\n        a child table whose canonical-edition parent is absent fails with foreign_keys enabled.\n        Treat those partial databases as having no reconstructable barrier rather than making\n        unrelated legacy upgrades fail.\n        """\n        required = {\n            "canonical_editions",\n            "spotify_matches",\n            "spotify_planner_matched_recovery_state",\n            "spotify_planner_unresolved_state",\n            "spotify_planner_persistence_rejection_state",\n        }\n        placeholders = ", ".join("?" for _ in required)\n        rows = connection.execute(\n            f"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name IN ({placeholders})",\n            tuple(sorted(required)),\n        ).fetchall()\n        if {str(row[0]) for row in rows} != required:\n            return\n\n        connection.execute(\n            """\n            INSERT OR IGNORE INTO spotify_planner_persistence_rejection_state (\n                source_id, source_native_id, protected_status,\n                protected_spotify_episode_uri, protected_spotify_duration_seconds,\n                protected_match_updated_at, first_rejected_at, last_rejected_at\n            )\n            SELECT m.source_id, m.source_native_id, m.status, m.spotify_episode_uri,\n                   m.spotify_duration_seconds, m.updated_at,\n                   r.first_attempt_at, r.last_attempt_at\n            FROM spotify_matches AS m\n            JOIN spotify_planner_matched_recovery_state AS r\n              ON r.source_id = m.source_id\n             AND r.source_native_id = m.source_native_id\n            WHERE m.status = 'matched' AND m.updated_at > r.first_attempt_at\n            """\n        )\n        connection.execute(\n            """\n            INSERT OR IGNORE INTO spotify_planner_persistence_rejection_state (\n                source_id, source_native_id, protected_status,\n                protected_spotify_episode_uri, protected_spotify_duration_seconds,\n                protected_match_updated_at, first_rejected_at, last_rejected_at\n            )\n            SELECT m.source_id, m.source_native_id, m.status, m.spotify_episode_uri,\n                   m.spotify_duration_seconds, m.updated_at,\n                   u.first_unresolved_at, u.last_attempt_at\n            FROM spotify_matches AS m\n            JOIN spotify_planner_unresolved_state AS u\n              ON u.source_id = m.source_id\n             AND u.source_native_id = m.source_native_id\n            WHERE m.status != 'matched' AND m.updated_at > u.last_attempt_at\n            """\n        )\n\n'''
persistence = replace_once(persistence, marker, helper, "seed helper insertion")
PERSISTENCE.write_text(persistence)

planner_tests = PLANNER_TESTS.read_text()
test_name = "test_schema_six_upgrade_seeds_implicit_persistence_rejection_barrier"
if test_name in planner_tests:
    raise SystemExit("migration seed regression already exists")
planner_tests += dedent(
    r'''


def test_schema_six_upgrade_seeds_implicit_persistence_rejection_barrier(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    store = _store(tmp_path)
    edition = _edition()
    store.upsert_editions((edition,), observed_at=NOW)
    assert store.set_match_state(
        *edition.identity,
        status=MatchStatus.MATCHED,
        spotify_episode_uri="spotify:episode:durable-a",
        spotify_duration_seconds=60,
        diagnostics="durable A",
        updated_at=NOW + timedelta(hours=4),
    )
    journal = SpotifyPlannerJournal(store)
    journal.record_matched_recovery(
        source_id="source",
        source_native_id="edition-one",
        input_fingerprint=SHA_A,
        attempted_at=NOW,
    )

    with sqlite3.connect(store.path) as connection:
        connection.execute("DROP TABLE spotify_planner_persistence_rejection_state")
        connection.execute("DELETE FROM schema_migrations WHERE version = 7")

    legacy = SQLiteStore(store.path)
    assert legacy.schema_version() == 6
    legacy.initialize()

    restarted = SpotifyPlannerJournal(SQLiteStore(store.path))
    barrier = restarted.get_persistence_rejection_barrier("source", "edition-one")
    assert barrier is not None
    durable = store.get_match_state(*edition.identity)
    assert durable is not None
    assert barrier.protects(durable)
    assert barrier.first_rejected_at == NOW
    assert barrier.last_rejected_at == NOW
'''
)
PLANNER_TESTS.write_text(planner_tests)
